# Frankie 1.1.26
- Adds explicit whole-desktop Computer Run control when approved, while retaining one-window mode. - Lets Frankie move between apps and interact across multiple displays during desktop-scoped runs. - Adds capability negotiation so older Mac builds cannot claim whole-desktop work. - Includes the latest desktop-control safeguards and production refinements from AskFrankie.
